motivation: In the two earlier training checks, the incumbent missed 400 rows and at least one of seven measured models was correct on 210 of those. This is retrospective oracle coverage only. Test whether a gate can identify the useful disagreements without their labels at prediction time.
design: Keep the elected equal probability pair as incumbent. Learn a binary correction only on rows where one of the available methods disagrees with it. Use each method's signed log-odds difference, the fraction dissenting, and repeated categories conditioned on the incumbent's predicted class. Use the incumbent confidence as an offset and fixed L2 weights 8 for model evidence and 16 for one-hot fields. Rare or unknown categories do not introduce an individual learned coefficient. The gate may retain every incumbent decision.
selection: On the 808 feedback rows, use four stratified group folds. Nominate only if out-of-fit flips gain three or more correct decisions in total and gain in at least two folds. Only a nominee is refit on all feedback and evaluated on the two previously used, separate development panels. To advance to a new independent experiment require no losses in either retained panel and a pooled gain at least .003. Count up to five supervised routing fits. No new base fits, language-model requests, designated validation or formal test.
